edit.title: Edit {{name}} permission role
edit.subtitle: Select the areas of your workspace that team members in this role can access and manage
edit.discardBody: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now they will be lost.
edit.ownerNote: The Workspace owner has full access to all areas. These permissions can't be changed.
edit.noneNote: Team members with No access can't access any workspace features. These permissions can't be changed.

matrix.insightsNote: Permissions for individual reports can be managed in Insights

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Allow access to the calendar and decide what actions they can perform.

items.view_others: Can view other team members' calendars
items.edit_preferred_member: Can edit preferred team member for an appointment
items.reassign: Can reassign appointments to another team member
items.no_show: Can mark appointments as a no-show
items.blocked_own: Can create a blocked time in their own calendar
items.blocked_all: Can create a blocked time for all team members
items.blocked_types: Can set up and change blocked time types for the workspace
items.book_unassigned_members: Can book a service with team members not assigned to deliver that service
items.book_unassigned_resources: Can book a service with resources not set up to deliver that service
items.link_own: Can link their own calendar to external calendars
items.link_own_export: Can export calendar items to an external calendar
items.link_own_import: Can import calendar items from an external calendar
items.link_any: Can link any calendar to external calendars
items.link_any_export: Can export calendar items to an external calendar
items.link_any_import: Can import calendar items from an external calendar

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Allow access to sales and decide what actions the team member can perform.

items.add_tip: Can add a tip during checkout
items.discount_items: Can apply discounts to individual items
items.view_closed_registers: Can view previously closed cash registers
items.cash_in_out: Can manually cash in or out
items.mid_day_count: Can do a count of the cash register mid-day
items.daily_summary: Can view the daily sales summary
items.appointments_list: Can view the list of appointments
items.gift_card_templates: Can view gift card templates in the catalog
items.packages_sold: Can view the list of packages sold
items.memberships_sold: Can view the list of memberships sold
items.sold_gift_cards: Can view the list of sold gift cards

hints.manage_registers: Team member can create, edit and archive cash registers
hints.mid_day_count: Requires mid-day count setting to be enabled for register

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Allow access to client profiles, the client list and decide what actions the team member can perform.

items.contact_details: Can view client's email and phone number
items.tags: Can add and remove tags from clients
items.view_form_responses: Can view client responses in consultation forms
items.complete_forms: Can complete consultation forms on behalf of clients
items.edit_forms: Can create and edit consultation forms
items.add_rewards: Can manually add client rewards to a client
items.notes_assigned: Can view client notes at assigned locations
items.notes_all_locations: Can view client notes at all locations
items.notes_edit: Can create and edit client notes
items.notes_edit_others: Can edit other team members' notes
items.segments: Can create and manage client segments
items.reputation_settings: Can manage Online reputation settings for the workspace
items.loyalty_view: Can view loyalty settings for the workspace
items.loyalty_settings: Can manage loyalty settings for the workspace

hints.client_sources: Client sources are labels that track how clients found your business (e.g. Walk-in, Instagram etc.)
hints.client_tags: Client tags are custom labels you can create and assign to clients to organize and filter them (e.g. VIP, Regular etc.)

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Allow access to the catalog and decide what actions the team members can perform.

items.services: Can create or change the services in the catalog
items.products: Can create or change the products in the catalog
items.import_products: Can import products to the catalog in bulk
items.bulk_products: Can perform bulk operations on the product catalog
items.gift_cards: Can create or change gift cards

online_profile.title: Online profile
online_profile.description: Allow access to the online profile and decide what actions the team members can perform.

items.online_booking: Can set up and manage online booking
items.product_store: Can set up and manage the online product store

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Allow access to marketing tools and decide what actions the team members can perform.

items.deals_view: Can view deals offered to clients
items.deals_edit: Can create or edit the deals offered to clients

hints.blast: Team member can create email and text blast marketing campaigns
hints.automations: Team member can view and manage automated messages sent to your clients

team.title: Team
team.description: Allow access to team management and decide what actions they can perform.

items.view_list: Can view the team member list
items.own_shifts: Can view their own scheduled shifts
items.manage_others_shifts: Can manage other team members' scheduled shifts
items.manage_others_timesheets: Can manage other team members' timesheets
items.compensation_settings: Can manage team member compensation settings
items.timesheet_settings: Can manage timesheet settings for the workspace

hints.pay_runs: Can pay out wages, commissions, and tips to team members
hints.compensation_settings: Required to view and edit team members' wages, commissions, and pay run details
hints.merchant_accounts: Merchant accounts enable payments directly from clients to team members

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Allow access to reports and decide what actions they can perform.

items.view_all_data: Can view all team members' data

payments_wallet.title: Payments and wallet
payments_wallet.description: Allow access to the business wallet and payment settings.

items.wallet_billing: Can access the business wallet and edit billing information
items.pos_settings: Can manage point of sale settings

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Allow access to business setup and other workspace settings.

items.all_locations: Can view and access all locations

hints.all_locations: Team member can perform actions for all locations, even those they are not assigned to
